The SMS says **yyopc hit its spending cap, so Kernel paused API access**. If accurate, Clanker’s Kernel browser tasks will fail until billing access is restored.

A trial can still have a usage cap before its end date. Kernel currently lists Start-up at **$200/month plus usage**, with $50/month in credits, so check the selected plan before adding a card. [Kernel pricing](https://dev.kernel.sh/pricing)

**Open [Kernel’s dashboard](https://dashboard.onkernel.com) directly and check Billing → usage, spending limit, and trial status.** The screenshot alone doesn’t verify the account state or the `subscribe.poke.com` link.
